# UI Specification v1 — VocalSat

**Framework:** WebView2 (HTML/CSS/JS)
**Contract:** `Design/v1-ui-map.json` (source of truth — the preview is composed from it)
**Preview:** `Design/v1-test.html` (generated by `node bin/apc.js ui-compose VocalSat`)

## Layout

- **Window:** 720 x 480 px base
- **Plate:** 45 x 30 grid cells (1 rem = 1 cell, 16 px at 1x)
- **Mode:** `scalable` — uniform scale, aspect ratio locked
- **Scale range:** 0.5x to 3.0x
- **Edge policy:** `letterbox` (fill token `--surface`)
- **Resize handle:** in-page corner gripper (bottom-right)
- **Presets:** 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0

### Sections

| Section | Cell (x,y,w,h) | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `mast` | 0.5, 0.5, 44, 3.25 | Brand and tagline |
| `meter-bay` | 1.5, 4, 22.5, 20 | VU meter |
| `controls` | 24.75, 4, 19.75, 20 | Drive / Tone / Mix + readouts + bypass |
| `footer` | 0.5, 25.75, 44, 3.75 | Oversampling and format notes |

### Grid structure

- Top mast spans the full width.
- Middle row: meter bay on the left (~50% width), saturation controls on the right.
- Three equal knob columns at x = 25.5, 32, 38.5 (6 cells wide each).
- Value readouts directly under each knob.
- Bypass switch under the readout row, left-aligned with Drive.
- Footer spans the full width.

## Controls

| Parameter | Type | Position (x,y,w,h) | Range | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `drive` | Rotary knob | 25.5, 6.5, 6, 8.5 | 0.0 - 24.0 dB | 6.0 dB |
| `tone` | Rotary knob | 32, 6.5, 6, 8.5 | -100.0 - 100.0 % | 0 % |
| `mix` | Rotary knob | 38.5, 6.5, 6, 8.5 | 0.0 - 100.0 % | 100 % |
| `drive-readout` | LED screen | 25.5, 15.75, 6, 2.25 | — | "6.0 dB" |
| `tone-readout` | LED screen | 32, 15.75, 6, 2.25 | — | "0 %" |
| `mix-readout` | LED screen | 38.5, 15.75, 6, 2.25 | — | "100 %" |
| `bypass` | Panel switch | 25.5, 20, 9, 3 | on/off | off |

**Non-interactive elements:** `brand`, `tagline`, `meter-label`, `footer-left`, `footer-right`, and the `meter` canvas (VU).

## Typography

- UI font: `"Bahnschrift", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif`
- Labels: 0.5 rem, 600 weight, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.12em
- Readouts: 0.75 rem, tabular numerals
- Micro text (footer): 0.4375 rem

## Style Notes

- **Vintage studio outboard:** warm dark metal, ivory silk-screen text, amber backlight.
- The VU meter is the visual anchor on the left; the three knobs are the interaction focus on the right.
- No skeuomorphic textures are authored by hand — the catalog renders controls and the composer stamps cells. Visual character comes from the token palette plus the built-in `vu-meter` canvas painter.
- Layout must remain legible down to 0.5x: labels use the catalog's legibility floors (`max(9px, …)`).
- All three knob labels and readouts share the same column grid so the panel reads as one instrument.

## Implementation Notes (for `/apc-impl`)

- Control DOM ids are emitted as `id="ctl-<id>"` with `data-param="<param>"`.
- Only `drive`, `tone`, `mix` are automatable; `bypass` is a UI switch (not in the v1 parameter spec).
- The VU meter canvas is a visual placeholder in the design preview; production metering uses live peak/RMS atomics.
- Do not invent elements outside this map — `apc validate ui` enforces DOM ↔ manifest parity.
